about: The Fourth Quarter's Blender style sheet as data (WISHLIST.md 'Blender assets' B1). validate.mjs reads it. Bytes are triangles x 128 + 8 KiB: the worst case of a flat-shaded triangle carrying its own three vertices (position, normal, float colour, 40 bytes each) and three 16-bit indices, plus the JSON chunk. extent is the longest side a class may have, in metres, a sanity bound only; each item's box is the one js/world.js gives the thing it replaces, at the Corner Tap's numbers, held to 10% per axis (x, y, z in three's frame). texture is the largest image side in pixels, and 0 means none: a keyed material's texture is the game's, put on at load. The palette is every flat() colour js/world.js draws the pack's pieces with, named for what wears it; a keyed material's colour is checked against MATS in js/textures.js instead.
